name: Jupiter Perpetual Exchange

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: The perps program's upgrade multisig has a 24-hour delay, but its application admin is a 4-of-7 Squads v3 multisig with no delay field, so the delay is bypassed. That multisig also controls Jupiter Aggregator v6 upgrades.
narrative.tag: admin path bypasses the 24h upgrade delay
narrative.detail: Program upgrade is a Squads v4 multisig, 4-of-8, 24h delay, moved on 2026-02-11 off the no-delay Squads v3 that still holds Aggregator v6. Perpetuals.admin was decoded at offset 51 of the 120-byte account and matches authority index 1 of Squads v3 multisig 7ZyDFz..., 4-of-7: the same multisig as Aggregator v6's upgrade authority, so one compromise reaches two large Jupiter products. The Doves oracle program shares the upgrade vault, but oracle authority for this target is still an open point. One verifier's claim that the admin PDA could not be reproduced was a bug in its own code. DefiLlama listed over $600M TVL.

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
main_gap.reason: Changes can apply with no waiting time

independent_read.path: account owned by program PERPHjGB… -> program -> ProgramData C258Lj… -> upgrade authority (a program-derived address, off the curve: a Squads vault or a protocol PDA, no key can sign for it directly) -> Squads v4 vault 0 of multisig AxkJ8oH5aDu4ZRWfsujPtxdb6Vhq4gDehpoReBgrUUSm
independent_read.disagree: the timelock score says no delay (0), the Squads multisig enforces a native time lock of 24 h
independent_read.posture: admin: Squads 4-of-8 of 8 plain keys; delay: 24 h Squads time lock
